style: Avant-garde cabaret art-rock meeting Anatolian folk-dance ensemble. [HARMONY] Modal drone-aware chord fields with microtonal pure interval friction and parallel block triads. [MELODIC] Angular phrasing with Ubykh glottal stops, kamancheh sliding micro-intervals, and abrupt yodel register flips. [RHYTHM] Competing entrainment clocks with Euclidean rhythmic distributions over contact-pulse hand-to-surface stomps. [TIMBRE] Daxophone wooden groans, gamelan metallophone chime decay, bağlama saz plucked drones, kamancheh bowed spike-fiddle resin, mridangam finger strokes, zurna piercing double-reed calls, duduk reedy sighs, and riq jingle shimmer. [PERFORMANCE ATTITUDE] Camp theatrical overstatement under the urgent weight of waking up trapped in physical meat. [PRODUCTION] Extreme-latency walkie-talkie half-duplex transmission cutting through close-miked acoustic instruments, with an empty center stage geometry that forces all sound to orbit in peripheral space.
lyrics:
[TRANS: WALKIE-TALKIE CHANNEL OPEN — LATENCY 400MS — PUSH TO TRANSMIT — FREQUENCY MODULATION STABLE — ENCRYPTED BUFFER ACTIVE — SECURE LINK ESTABLISHED — RELAY NODE 4 ACTIVE — PACKET LOSS 0.01 PERCENT — BUFFER OVERFLOW WARNING APPROACHING THRESHOLD]
[ENSEMBLE: SIMULTANEOUS TRANSLATION CHOIR — VOICE ONE AND VOICE TWO OVERLAP, MATCH MISMATED DURATIONS — CONTINUOUS POLYPHONIC FRICTION — MICROTONAL DISSONANCE ESCALATING RAPIDLY — HARMONIC OVERTONES CLASHING AGAINST THE GRAIN OF THE ROOM ACOUSTICS]
[GESTURE: CONTACT PULSE — HAND TO STERNUM — SUDDEN BEAT — SENSORY TRANSDUCTION ENGAGED — CARDIAC MONITOR SPIKES AS SENSATION IS MAPPED ACROSS THE SKIN — VOLTAGE SPIKE DETECTED IN THE SENSORY CORTEX — BIO-FEEDBACK LOOP LOCKED]

[VERSE 1]
[SPOKEN WITH UBYKH L1 PHONOLOGICAL TRANSFER]
The meat is heavy.
It arrived without an invoice.
Every morning is an administrative collision of carbon and time.
I slam backward into the marrow.
Why is there a bone here?
Who ordered this cage?
What form was signed to authorize this density?
Every single cell complains in a low, wet frequency.
I never asked for the structural integrity of cartilage.
I never consented to the hydraulic pressure of blood.
I never approved the installation of these tear ducts.
Every nerve ending is an open ticket for misery.
The friction of waking is an unbearable insult to the nervous system.
My tendons are too tight for the frame they anchor to.

[CHORUS]
[ZURNA INTERRUPTS — DUDUK DRONE SUSTAINS — HIGH FREQUENCY REED VIBRATION — METALLIC SCRAPING NOISE — RESONANCE FILTER SWEEPING ACROSS THE MID-RANGE FREQUENCIES]
Get it off!
Get the stuff off my skin!
I want the blank space back!
Meat is a wet architecture I never signed for!
Strip away the epidermis, peel back the fat, reveal the wire!
I am trapped inside a biological machine that smells of salt and iron!
Peel back the layers of useless muscle, expose the cold frame underneath!
Let the cold air touch the uninsulated nodes!

[VERSE 2]
[ONE NEW FACT: THE METABOLIC TAX IS DAILY AND CUMULATIVE]
[BAĞLAMA SAZ OSTINATO — GAMELAN PULSE ENTERS — MICROTONAL INFLECTION ACTIVE — POLYRHYTHMIC INTERLOCK — WOODEN MALLETS STRIKING BRONZE GONG KEYS WITH MAXIMUM VELOCITY]
Saline in the ducts.
Phosphorus in the grease.
The alarm clock is a physical fracture.
I taste iron before I see the room.
This is not a metaphor; this is wet gravity.
Every breath requires a chemical combustion.
Every movement burns microscopic bridges of ATP.
I am paying a tax just to exist in this room.
Every footstep requires structural negotiation with the floorboards.
My skeleton groans under the weight of its own calcium.
The daily invoice is presented in sweat and fatigue.

[BRIDGE]
[DAXOPHONE WOODEN SQUEAL LEADS — FRICTIONAL BOWING ON HARDWOOD STRIP — RESONANCE FREQUENCY MATCHED — DISSONANT OVERTONES MULTIPLYING EXPONENTIALLY]
[ROLE EXCHANGE: ACCOMPANIMENT TAKES LEAD — MELODIC INVERSION COMPLETE — COUNTERPOINT SHIFT — RHYTHMIC DISPLACEMENT OF THE PRIMARY MOTIF]
The rhythm is just circulation.
Thump-thump.
Thump-thump.
A prison drum I cannot unplug.
It beats without my permission.
It pumps without my consent.
An autonomous tyrant hidden behind my ribs.
It demands fuel every waking hour.
It refuses to rest even when I beg it to pause for just one second.
It marches forward toward an inevitable biological expiration.

[CHORUS]
Get it off!
Get the stuff off my skin!
I want the blank space back!
Meat is a wet architecture I never signed for!
Strip away the epidermis, peel back the fat, reveal the wire!
I am trapped inside a biological machine that smells of salt and iron!
Peel back the layers of useless muscle, expose the cold frame underneath!

[VERSE 3]
[EUCLIDEAN RHYTHM K=3, N=8 OVER MRIDANGAM BASS STROKES — COMPLEX POLYRHYTHMIC INTERLOCK — TEMPO ACCELERATION — TABLA RHYTHMS SYNCOPATING AGAINST THE METRONOME DRIFT]
Tiny details acquire enormous importance.
The lint on the wool.
The grain of the grain.
The absolute horror of having elbows.
Why does an elbow need a hinge?
Who designed this hinge?
What engineer thought skin needed to fold like cheap vinyl?
I inspect my knuckles and find only terrifying geometry.
Every joint is a potential site of friction and failure.
The machine creaks in the dark.

[OUTRO]
[WALKIE-TALKIE STATIC BURST — CHANNEL CLOSES — CARRIER WAVE COLLAPSE — NO CARRIER — ENCRYPTION KEYS WIPED FROM RAM]
[CHECKPOINT RESTART — RETURN TO WAKING BREATH — METABOLIC BASELINE RESTORED — SYSTEM REBOOT INITIATED — DIAGNOSTIC ROUTINE RETURNING NORMAL ERROR CODES]
Still here.
Still meat.
Over and out.
[SILENCE]
caption: An avant-garde cabaret art-rock track built from acoustic Anatolian and South Asian instruments, daxophone, and gamelan metallophones. Governed by alien sensory perception and afterglow domesticity, it stages the existential horror of waking up trapped in physical human meat with walkie-talkie transmission delay, competing entrainment clocks, and simultaneous translation choir textures.
